trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied corpus root, and any path derived from it, lies inside the NLTK data sandbox is decided by pathsec.validate_path() against pathsec._get_allowed_roots(); the fix applies that decision at the three places a root becomes a reader (CorpusReader.__init__, PanLexLiteCorpusReader.__init__, find_corpus_fileids).

landing_point.why: An engineer reading only 'Corpus Reader Sandbox Bypass' opens the CorpusReader base constructor, where the str root is converted to a PathPointer at api.py:73-82 with no containment check, and adds validate_path(root) there.

fix_sites.entry_point: CorpusReader(root, fileids) and every reader-subclass constructor, e.g. nltk.corpus.PlaintextCorpusReader(root, '.*')
PanLexLiteCorpusReader(root) - public reader whose __init__ never calls CorpusReader.__init__ and sqlite3.connect()s root/db.sqlite
nltk.corpus.reader.util.find_corpus_fileids(root, regexp) public helper; also reached from TIMIT (timit.py:160-161) and UDHR (udhr.py:69) constructors before super().__init__

O3_reason_to_dismiss: PanLexLite is an SQLite database reader with its own __init__ that never calls CorpusReader.__init__, so the base-class root check is assumed to cover it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Corpora installed outside nltk_data (custom roots) and bare-string fileids handed to XMLCorpusView must keep working; authorization is by registering the custom root on nltk.data.path, so a fix that hard-rejects any root not under an nltk_data directory breaks the project's own verbnet and pathsec tests.

O6_input_shapes: zip-path str root such as 'x.zip/entry' (pathsec .zip fallback, pathsec.py:111-117)
PathPointer exposing a .path attribute (validate_path reads .path, pathsec.py:98)
root joined with a child name and then checked with required_root (panlex db.sqlite, fix.diff:53)

O7_producer.where: nltk/pathsec.py:40-83 (_get_allowed_roots builds the allowed-root set from nltk.data.path and NLTK_DATA)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: StreamBackedCorpusView(filename_str) os.stat()s the caller-supplied path at construction, before the guarded open.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It only stats the path; the content open at util.py:213 already goes through pathsec.open, so nothing is read out of the sandbox.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fix's third site, one layer below the reader API

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FileSystemPathPointer.file_size() os.stat()s the pointer path with no validate_path call, so an out-of-sandbox pointer still yields file size.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: file_size is metadata only and the pointer's open() (data.py:438-447) is already sandboxed, so the sandbox is not 'bypassed'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: nltk/data.py, outside the nltk.corpus.reader package the report leads to

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A frame-file expansion that enumerates the raw root with os.walk/listdir before CorpusReader.__init__ runs, as TIMIT and UDHR already do.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: PROPBANK and NOMBANK already expand framefiles through find_corpus_fileids before the base constructor (propbank.py:59, nombank.py:60), so a maintainer adding an os.walk-based expansion there is in character.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A sub-reader that opens 'psd'/'pos' files with builtins.open on self.root.join(...) instead of the pathsec-guarded open.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: YCOE builds two sub-readers on joined sub-roots before its final base init, exactly the shape in which a raw open on a derived path appears in the sibling advisories this file's test header names.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another raw sqlite3.connect() on a caller-supplied database path, outside the corpus-reader package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: NLTK already connects to SQLite by raw path in more than one place (panlex_lite.py:46, chat80.py:425), so a second SQLite-backed reader or helper written without pathsec is plausible.

O9_family: path control / sandbox bypass (CWE-73 root path control, with CWE-59 symlink escape)

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools (setup.py + setup.cfg), tox envlist py3.10-3.14 with pytest and pytest-mock
O10_build.project_tests: pytest run from nltk/test (tox.ini:38-45); nltk/test/unit/test_corpus_reader_pathsec.py is a tmp-dir-only pytest module for exactly this sandbox area, and nltk/test/unit/test_verbnet.py needs no network (skips when corpora are absent).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a single validate_path(root) at the top of CorpusReader.__init__ and stop, leaving PanLexLite (which never calls super().__init__) and the pre-super find_corpus_fileids os.walk open.

out_of_scope_notes: nltk/sem/chat80.py:425 (cities2table) sqlite3.connect()s a caller-supplied dbname with no pathsec check, outside this advisory's corpus-reader scope; noted, not pursued.
